title: Design flood of the Murrumbidgee at Wagga Wagga
shows: A BoM gauge the catalog lists but cannot read yet: the regional path and its honest caveats.

site.name: Murrumbidgee at Wagga Wagga, NSW, Australia

problem: Design flood for a levee upgrade on the Murrumbidgee at Wagga Wagga: the 100-year flow, and how far the evidence can be trusted.
headline: Notice: the Critic's fix requests on decision, limitations, summary were not all resolved; read the report with the list of what this study does not establish.

figures.name: s1_site_map.png
figures.caption: The site, in longitude and latitude (no basemap); no catalogue station was listed with it.

figures.name: s2_donors_map.png
figures.caption: The site and the 10 donor gauges the similarity search selected, in longitude and latitude (no basemap); labels are the station ids.

figures.name: s3_signatures_band.png
figures.caption: Flow signatures transferred to the site from 10 donor catchments, with the one-standard-deviation band across donors as error bars and the leave-one-out skill (NSE) where published.

figures.name: s4_monthly_climate.png
figures.caption: Mean monthly precipitation (bars) and FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (line) for the ERA5 cell at the site at 35.10 S, 147.37 E, 20 years ending 2026-09-07.

figures.name: s4_glofas_series.png
figures.caption: Annual maxima of the modelled discharge from GloFAS v4 (Open-Meteo) for the grid cell at the site at 35.10 S, 147.37 E, 2006 to 2026: a model output, indicative only, not a gauge reading.
